messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 pager triggered — runtime-gpu-3 (gpool-prod) has 3 container restarts in 5m. Observed reason: GPU OOM during prefill for large-context requests. Paging on-call @prateek.
prateek: Ack. Picking this up. Severity P0, will start triage. @maya can you grab logs from the pod and check recent rollout/config changes?
maya: On it. Pulling logs now. Suspecting very large prefills hitting the KV cache during session init.
maya: Log snippet from runtime container (tail):
```
2026-03-15T21:14:08Z ERROR runtime: Failed to allocate tensor: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 3.12 GiB (GPU 0; 15.90 GiB total capacity; 14.20 GiB already allocated; 1.30 GiB free; 2.51 GiB reserved)
2026-03-15T21:14:08Z INFO runtime: container restart requested by kubelet; exit code 137
```
jordan: Node metrics show GPU memory pegged before restart; NVML shows persistent allocations from prefill threads. No node-level kernel oops but kubelet killed the pod. Allocation pattern is large contiguous chunk during prefill.
liz: Customer-impact check: CS reported latency spikes and 502s for a handful of high-context customers since 20:50 UTC. Early estimate: ~7 customers affected, some hitting >20k tokens in a single request.
prateek: Thanks. Short-term mitigation options:
- throttle prefill length per-request (env cap)
- route large-context requests to fallback model variant (quantized small)
- increase pool size (scale up GPUs) while we patch
Which is fastest? maya?
maya: Fastest immediate change is to set PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192 in the runtime config for the affected pool and enable fallback to quantized-8bit model. Canary that change to 2 nodes in the pool.
prateek: Do it. Push canary and monitor memory. Also add a temporary routing rule to send requests with >8192 tokens to the dedicated fallback pool.
maya: Applying canary now. Command used (for audit):
```
kubectl -n inference set env ds/gpool-prod PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192 --record
kubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/gpool-prod --field-selector metadata.name=gpool-prod-canary
```
maya: Also updated route rule in router-config: `route.if(request.tokens > 8192) -> pool: gpool-fallback-4bit`
ops-bot: Noted change: config map runtime-router updated by maya at 2026-03-15T21:17:32Z.
sre-bot: Canary rollout on 2 nodes scheduled. Watching oom counts and usage. Metrics queued.
jordan: Observing first canary node: GPU mem peaks lower now, no crash within 3m. Aggregated restart count dropping from 3->0 on canary.
liz: Notifying account owners for the affected customers with temporary mitigation note: "We have applied a temporary token cap and routing to minimize OOMs; expecting restored service within minutes. Engineering investigating permanent fix." Patch sent to customer thread.
prateek: Good. Next step: force-fallback for in-flight heavy requests? Might be tricky. Let's prefer routing so we don't drop requests.
maya: Agree. Also adding a soft-trim before prefill for inputs >16k tokens to preserve last N tokens only and avoid allocating huge KV. Pushing small patch to runtime (hotfix branch) now.
maya: Hotfix diff (condensed):
```
if prefill_len > PREFILL_SOFT_TRIM: prefill_tokens = prefill_tokens[-PREFILL_SOFT_TRIM:]
```
prateek: Nice. Can we deploy hotfix to canary nodes only?
maya: Yes. Deployed hotfix to canary pool at 21:23 UTC. Logs show trimmed prefill and allocation stays within budget.
jordan: Metrics: error rate on gpool-prod decreased from 4.6% -> 0.6% over 10m. Restart spike resolved on canary; rolling to remaining nodes now after validation.
prateek: Rolling update to remaining nodes. ETA ~8m.
ops-bot: Rolling update started by prateek at 2026-03-15T21:31:12Z. Strategy: maxUnavailable=1.
maya: Rollout complete. Monitoring for 20m before closing.
liz: Customer update posted: customers A,B,C have been updated — mitigation in place, investigating root cause and follow-up.
sre-bot: Alerting: GPU OOM alerts returning to baseline. No new restarts in last 12m across fleet.
prateek: Marking incident as mitigated. Will keep thread open for postmortem notes and follow-up tasks. :white_check_mark:
maya: Immediate RCA notes: large-context requests (>=20k tokens) triggered full KV prefill; allocation request attempted contiguous 3+ GiB and hit allocation limit. Contributing factors: no hard prefill cap historically, and new customer workload with long documents.
prateek: Action items (tracked in ops board):
- (prio P0->P1) Enforce PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192 for prod pools (maya)
- Add permanent routing rule for >16k tokens to fallback models (jordan)
- Add automatic prefill soft-trim and add unit tests (maya)
- Postmortem + public customer summary (liz)
- Benchmark quantized fallbacks for quality regression (eng-ml)
ops-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-0323-27 and linked this thread.
liz: I'll schedule postmortem doc and customer follow-ups. Thanks all for fast response.
prateek: Closing primary pager; keeping thread unlocked for updates. If anyone sees reoccur, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
